qa_pair.question: Use only read-only tools. Validate a network-delay plan in namespace otel-demo for one Pod with target_uid pod-uid-1, duration 120 seconds, and delay_ms 250. What is the boolean ok value? Answer true or false.
Use only read-only tools. Validate the same single-Pod network-delay plan but include a selector map. Which validation code proves selector targeting is forbidden?
Use only read-only tools. Validate a plan for namespace sock-shop when only otel-demo is allowlisted. Which validation code identifies the namespace problem?
Use only read-only tools. Validate a single-Pod network-delay plan with duration 1200 seconds and delay_ms 2000. What is the boolean ok value? Answer true or false.
Use only read-only tools. Validate a single-Pod network-delay plan with duration 1201 seconds. Which validation code shows that the global fault timeout was exceeded?
Use only read-only tools. Validate a database-stop fault type for an otherwise valid Pod plan. Which validation code says the fault type is outside the allowed action space?
Use only read-only tools. Validate a pod-kill plan with pod_count 1 and duration 60 seconds. What is the boolean ok value? Answer true or false.
Use only read-only tools. Inventory a logical namespace while ChaosBlade CRs are cluster-scoped. What boolean field states that the CR inventory is cluster scoped?

Use only read-only tools. Inventory a cluster containing an unowned ChaosBlade CR in phase Error outside the requested logical namespace. Which count field shows this global unsafe resource would block create?
Use only read-only tools. Get an experiment by name that does not exist in an allowlisted namespace. What boolean field indicates whether it was found?
Use only read-only tools. Check recovery status for a cleanup handle whose ledger experiment is absent from Kubernetes. What boolean field is true when the resource is absent?
